entities.doc: Adverse event report — SAE, AEFI, ICSR, Pharmaco/Materio/Haemovigilance.
Immutable workflow history entry for an application.

Central application object driven by the generic workflow engine. Covers the full regulatory lifecycle: registration, market authorisation, licensing, renewal, endorsement, post-approval change, suspension, surrender, appeal, NOC, clinical trial, etc.
Batch Release Certificate (BRC) for biologicals, incl. SLP scrutiny.
Issued certificate or NOC (COPP, FSC, MSC, NCC, WC, GMP, NOCs, codes).
Clinical trial / GCT / BA-BE / PMS / academic / veterinary field trial.
Compensation claim arising from a serious adverse event in a trial.
Prosecution / court case + Action Taken Report tracking.
Enforcement case — quality monitoring, sampling, NSQ/spurious detection, investigations and inter-state coordination.
Configurable fee rule used to auto-calculate application fees.
Grievance / complaint ticket with SLA & escalation tracking.

Site inspection — manufacturing, joint (Centre+State), BA/BE, CRO, blood centre, retail, WC, medical device, etc. Captures geo-tag and form data (Form-35 / MD-11 / COS-11). Supports joint consolidated reporting.
Supply & distribution invoice.
Testing Laboratory registry — Central (CDL/CDTL/RDTL/IPC/NIB), State and Private labs. Onboardable without code changes (RFP requirement).
Issued licence (manufacturing, import, sale, test, loan, etc.).
Generic reference master-data registry (drug categories, dosage forms, blood types, states, zones, etc.). Extensible without code changes.

Regulated entity registry — manufacturers, importers, exporters, wholesalers/retailers, CROs, ethics committees, blood centres, BA/BE centres, consultants, marketers. Acts as a source-of-truth registry.
Fee payment record (Bharat Kosh / State Treasury — simulated gateway).
Product registry across all regulated categories (drugs, biologicals, medical devices, IVDs, cosmetics, veterinary, AYUSH, blood products).
Periodic Safety Update Report.
Product recall record with supplied vs recalled quantity tracking.
Reference standard validated/issued by laboratories.
Periodic return filing (production/sales/consumption/stock) — GST/ITR style.
Lab sample received for testing.
Batch in the supply chain (QR-traceable from source to consumption).
A movement event of a batch between supply-chain entities.

Technical Person registry.  Business rule (RFP): a technical person can be associated with only ONE manufacturer / laboratory / blood bank / wholesaler / retailer at a time. Enforced via a unique registrationNo and single organizationId, with the service rejecting attempts to attach an already-engaged person elsewhere.
Laboratory test report for a sample.
Clinical trial / GCT / BA-BE / PMS / academic / veterinary field trial.
Records random/auto/manual allocation of work (applications, inspections, sample testing) to officers — supports masked assignment and manual override.
